Read more in the official group {wormix_club_text} Nobody believed in them. Everyone thought they were simply a fairy tale. But they returned, wielding fire! Real. Flying ... Dragons! You get a clone of your friend preserving his race and with the same attack and armor distribution. Clone's level increases just as yours, but not exceeding friend's level. You can put on any hat or artifact on the clone. You hire a mercenary with fixed level and items. Most mercenaries level up with your level. You get a clan mate with full equipment. This unit becomes inactive, if either you or he leaves a clan. You may only hire clan mates with level lesser or equal to yours. "Battle backpack" stores the weapons deployed in combat. "Storage" contains weapons which you own but don't want to take into battle. Drag weapons from Storage to Backpack to make them available." Your rating is transformed rating level: {current} / {next} From now on you don't loose rating after defeats.
Become a Legend of Wormix, by reaching the highest rating levels! Legends are the player with the highest rating values! Get chests for winning wagers and open them using battle tokens!
Hint!
Buying multiple VIPs will extend their duration! When you transfer profile, you keep all your money, weapons, items, level and achievements. You only loose your friends and your clan. And your current profile in this social network will be blocked! Lost connection to the server.

Attempted reconnection ({value})... A permanent +{hpPct}% health bonus. Boxer gets protection from physical attacks +{valueDefenseFrom}-{valueDefenseTo}% (depending on attack parameter). The percentage of protection increases with the level of boxer. At start of squad member's turn, increase their attack by {valueAdditionTo} until end of turn. I The poison deals {valuePoison}% more damage. At start of its turn, Demon temporarily grants each squad's unit ability to breathe underwater until that unit takes its turn. Ability ignores device for switch turn and is deactivated when the leader dies. Rabbits get +{speed} speed, +{valueJumpPowerBonus} jump power and additional jump in air. When you press Shift and jump key at the same time, rabbit does a powered jump. When a rabbit has less than {valueThreshold}% health, he starts nibbling carrots at the beginning of each turn of the enemy team, restoring {valueHealFrom}-{valueHealTo} hp, depending on the initial health. When rabbit passes an ally having less than {valueFriendly}% health, rabbit shares a healing carrot with them. Allies can also approah rabbit themselves to get a carrot. After the death of the zombie, the charge of negative energy is released upon its killer, dealing 30 damage and poisoning for 10 turns. Enemies killed by the zombie rise from their graves to fight against former comrades. Raised zombies have darker color and no racial bonuses. Revived zombie has 0 armor, maximum attack and {hpEachLevelValue} health per level. Once per turn you can freely use 1 charge of turn switch on a zombie which is revived this way. Cats are able to climb walls and ceiling. Press the jump button twice to catch hold. Also cats get increase speed +{valueClimbingSpeed} in this state. When cat is below {valueHpPercent}% health, they get {valueChance}% chance to evade most attacks. Every successful evasion increases cat's attack value by {valueAddAttack} until the end of the battle (max +{valueMaxAttack}). Cat also dodges all attacks from the allies. When cat and his party deal {valueDamageThreshold} or more damage to an enemy, they cause bleeding wounds on enemies. Damaged enemies take an additional {valueInDamagePercent}% of wounding damage (up to {valueLimitDamage}) over {valueTurnDuration} turns. Bleeding is treated treated with bandage and doctor bag. The dragon leaves a trail of embers (up to {valueEmbers}), that ignite on the next turn, burn until {valueTurns} turns and can damage the enemy by {valueDamage} hp. When allies end their turn in dragon's fire, they restore {valueHeal} hp and get +{valueAttackOnHeal} attack until the end of the battle (up to +{valueMaxAttack}). Personal protective droid, which is created at the beginning of robot's turn and operates until its next turn. In 3 seconds after detecting an enemy, the droid emits an electrical charge that damages enemy by {valueDroneDamage}. A droid can be destroyed by any weapon. Deals {valueDamage} shock damage to enemies near the robot. Also counterattacks enemies in close range after receiving more than {valueCounterThreshold} damage, dealing {valueCounterDamage} shock damage. When dealing at least {valueMinDamage} damage to enemies, Robot and members of its squad reduce their armor by {valueReduceFrom}-{valueReduceTo} for {valueTurnDuration} turns. Maximum reduction is reached at {valueMaxDamage} damage. Rhino can perform powerful stomp, that deals up to {valueDamage} damage and destroys the ground, activated by the jump button in the air. The efficiency depends on the rhino's level, speed, and additional jump bonuses. Stomp power also decreases with each application, a total of {valueStomps} per battle can be made. Natural ability to survive in harsh conditions, providing +{valueResists}% protection from fire, cold and shock. Also gives +{fortitude} weighting protecting against pushback from attacks. Upon receiving fatal damage, the alien stays alive with 1 hp and becomes immune to all damage unitl their next turn. Increases fuel of such weapons as UFO, helicopter, boars, and jetpack by {bonusFuel}% and duration of such devices as blockers, grounding bot, force field by {deviceDuration} turns. At the beginning of team's turn takes away {valueWeakness}% of protections from fire, cold, shock, and air strikes from the nearest enemy (protection can't become less than zero). Each attack on the target restores {valueRestore} of lost protection ({valueRestoreFire} for fire protection), up to the initial value. At the end of the turn dissolution disappears completely. At the end of the turn, the boar poisons nearby enemies for {valuePoison} turns and reduces their attack for {valueReduceFrom}-{valueReduceTo} until the end of their next turn. The reduction efficiency of the ability increases with the level of boar. Attention! Leadership is deactivated when the leader dies or is the last fighter in a squad. Boar can charge on short distance forward or upward. To charge forward, press jump twice; to charge upward, backflip twice. When boar collides with the ground it deals crushing blow for {valueDashDamage} damage. Available 2 crushing blows per turn. For each boar's {valueLost} hp lost, himself and his teammates get +{valueAlly} to attack (+{valueMaxAllyAttack} max). Also, each teammate increases himself for his own loss of health. Received attack persists if leader dies.
